harness.name: OpenAI API SDK — Node
recommended_when: Low-level typed OpenAI API access from JS/TS

capabilities.summary: Typed JavaScript/TypeScript access to the OpenAI API.
invocation: import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI();

evidence.claim: Typed JavaScript/TypeScript access to the OpenAI API.
Invocation verified: npm install openai, import OpenAI from 'openai'; const client = new OpenAI();

capabilities.summary: Streaming and typed response objects support machine-readable application logic.

evidence.claim: Streaming and typed response objects support machine-readable application logic.
Invocation verified: client.responses.create({text: {format: {type: 'json_schema', strict: true, schema: ...}}}), client.responses.parse() with zodTextFormat()

capabilities.summary: Model and API feature parameters are exposed as generated typed interfaces.

evidence.claim: Model and API feature parameters are exposed as generated typed interfaces.
